item.title: 583 Afghan Taliban killed as Pakistan continues strikes under Operation Ghazab lil-Haq
item.description: Information Minister Attaullah Tarar said on Sunday that 583 Afghan Taliban operatives have been killed and more than 795 injured during the ongoing Operation Ghazab lil-Haq, launched in response to what Islamabad described as “unprovoked action” from across the Afghan border, AzerNEWS reports, citing Tribune.

item.title: Explosion at US embassy in Oslo may have been terrorism, Norway police say
item.description: An overnight explosion at the US embassy in Oslo may have been an act of terrorism, AzerNEWS reports, citing Azertag.

item.title: China foreign minister blasts Middle East war, urges US to manage ties
item.description: China’s top diplomat condemned on Sunday the war in the Middle East and urged the United States to iron out its differences with Beijing, AzerNEWS reports, citing Arab News.

item.title: President of Iran Masoud Pezeshkian has phone call with President Ilham Aliyev
item.description: On March 8, President of the Islamic Republic of Iran Masoud Pezeshkian made a phone call to President of the Republic of Azerbaijan Ilham Aliyev.

item.title: New hunt for flight MH370 ends with no clues to 12-year mystery
item.description: The latest search for Malaysia Airlines flight MH370, which went missing 12 years ago in one of aviation’s greatest enduring mysteries, concluded in January without yielding any findings, Malaysia’s transport ministry said on Sunday, AzerNews reports, citing Arab News.

item.title: Israel strikes Iran’s oil refineries: what it means for Middle East
item.description: The recent attacks by Israel on Iran’s oil refineries mark an unprecedented escalation in Middle Eastern geopolitics. For the first time, a key economic artery of Iran, namely, its energy infrastructure has been directly targeted, signaling that the region is entering a new phase of strategic confrontation.

item.title: Bangladesh imposes fuel purchase limits
item.description: Authorities in Bangladesh have begun imposing restrictions on fuel purchases at gas stations as concerns grow over supply disruptions linked to instability in the Middle East, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: Brent and WTI crude jump above $115 as energy markets react to geopolitical risks
item.description: Global oil prices surged sharply on international energy markets amid rising geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and concerns over potential threats to critical energy infrastructure. item.title: Iran announces loyalty pledge to new Supreme Leader after death of Ali Khamenei
item.description: On March 8, the Assembly of Experts elected Mojtaba Khamenei by majority vote as Iran’s third Supreme Leader. He is the son of Ayatollah Seyyed Ali Khamenei, who was killed on February 28 during military airstrikes carried out by the United States and Israel.

item.title: Europe accounts for one-third of global arms imports
item.description: Between 2021 and 2025, Europe’s arms imports increased more than threefold compared with the 2016–2020 period.
